title: What's New in Cloth NeXt 2.9.40
subtitle: Cloud Bakes are on their way.

highlights.title: Cloud Bakes
highlights.description: Choose Cloud as Bake Location to simulate on PolyWorks GPUs. It unlocks as soon as the PolyWorks Cloud service is ready.

highlights.title: Live Cloud status
highlights.description: The Bake window follows a Cloud job with live server data: upload, queue, frames, cost limit and download.

highlights.title: Cleaner tools
highlights.description: Water Flow needs GAIA access, legacy coupling controls are gone, and the Sewing toolbar matches Blender's navigation buttons.
